title: CI/CD Fundamentals
description: Build a tool-independent understanding of Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and Continuous Deployment — pipelines, artifacts, environments, security, and reliability — before learning a specific platform such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD.

nodes.label: Why CI/CD Exists
nodes.description: Understand the failure modes of manual software delivery — forgotten steps, inconsistent environments, and fear of deploying — and articulate why automating a pipeline is meant to make changes smaller, repeatable, testable, and safer rather than merely faster.
